text:
Lina (Product): quick async check — Q2 cross-cut milestone rollup. TL;DR: billing routing shipped to canary, model-cache experiment slipped, autoscale config PR blocked. Owners and asks below.

Sam (Eng Runtime): shipped billing routing v2 to canary yesterday — perf looks stable on 95p (~80ms). :tada:

Priya (Eng Platform): autoscale config PR #412 is blocked on the infra-tests suite (node-spin). trying to repro in staging now. pinging @Derek for help.

Derek (Eng SRE): on it. running repro — logs show memory OOM on spot-2 nodes. pushed a temporary resource bump to staging to gather runs. excerpt:
```
2026-03-17T10:12:45Z kubelet: eviction threshold reached, memory reclaim triggered
2026-03-17T10:12:46Z kubelet: container "inference-runtime" killed due to memory
```
I'll annotate PR with the findings.

Anu (QA): cache experiment test plan ready, but seeing intermittent failures on long-context tests ( > 8k tokens ). filed bug #2137 with one flaky trace. I can re-run once autoscale change lands.

Kai (Design): flag — for degraded cache path we should show inline spinner + lightweight message (not full modal). small UX tweak, low effort but improves perceived latency.

Sam (Eng Runtime): CR pings: PR #399 (kv-cache) needs 1 more reviewer, and #412 (autoscale) needs infra validation. @Priya @Lina please take a look. added a short repro to the PR description.

Lina (Product): next steps recap: Priya/Derek to unblock autoscale by EOD Mon; Sam to finish kv-cache CR; Anu to re-run QA after infra patch. If anything slips past Tue, we'll freeze the canary and fall back to dedicated rollout. :eyes:

Priya (Eng Platform): noted. will attach test artifacts to #412 after the next run. @Anu can you paste the failing log into #2137? helps correlate.

Anu (QA): done — added timestamps, env, and failing stack. also added steps to reproduce and dataset sample. :white_check_mark:

Derek (Eng SRE): temp node bump merged to staging (resource increase + eviction threshold tweak). monitoring memory and pod churn. will rollback when stable. adjusted alert PSR-evict to reduce noise.

deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: autoscale-bump -> staging (rev: cb9a7e). CI summary: 64/66 checks passed, 2 flaky infra tests queued for rerun.

Lina (Product): thanks — I'll fold this into the weekly OKR snapshot. quick asks: Sam, add p95/p99 perf to the deck; Priya, update ETA after EOD check; Derek, paste stabilization window once observed.

Sam (Eng Runtime): will add perf numbers and a 1-slide note on canary health.

Priya (Eng Platform): ETA: EOD Mon (barring infra flake). will update thread.

Lina (Product): closing async here for the rollup — if anything urgent pops, please ping on #eng-oncall and drop a brief update in this thread. thanks all!
